subject: general
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

A slap on the wrist
solution:
The correct answer is: **'A small punishment'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** 'A slap on the wrist'** is used in English to mean a very mild punishment or a token reprimand. ("मामूली सज़ा")

 
 
• **Example: **When her son came late for dinner, he got a slap on the wrist from his mother, nothing more than a stern warning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **A small punishment**.
